title: Dedicated Server Hosting
content:
## Dedicated Server Hosting


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000100524

Not everyone needs enterprise-level hosting, but if your website traffic is increasing, we have premium hosting solutions to scale with your business needs.

```
Get This Service Visit our website: Dedicated Server Hosting
```


## Pricing


Here are the pricing details, along with a brief explanation of what is included with each server option.

Dedicated Server Specs Server CPU: 8 Core Intel Xeon 2620v4 Server RAM: 16 GB Server Storage: 2 x 1 TB HDD RAID Configuration: RAID 1 Backup Storage: 2 TB HDD Server Bandwidth: 15 TB / Month* Dedicated IP: 1 IPv4 Address / Server Ideal For Up To: 10 Websites † Included SSLs: 5 SSLs for 5 Websites Enterprise Server Specs Server CPU: 2 x 8 Core Intel Xeon 2620v4 Server RAM: 32 GB Server Storage: 2 x 1 TB SSD RAID Configuration: RAID 1 Backup Storage: 2 TB HDD Server Bandwidth: 15 TB / Month* Dedicated IP: 1 IPv4 Address / Server Ideal For Up To: 50 Websites † Included SSLs: 10 SSLs for 10 Websites Your own dedicated server for use with up to 10 websites. Upgraded hardware compared to Dedicated Server: Dual 8 Core Xeon CPU, 2X more RAM and faster SSD storage.


### Important Notes


- Each Dedicated Server and Enterprise Server has a one-time setup fee of $247, regardless of configuration. Transfer of your website(s) from our standard website hosting to your dedicated server typically takes 5–10 business days.

- * Additional bandwidth usage for Dedicated Servers or Enterprise Servers surpassing the 15 TB monthly limit is charged at a rate of $0.09 / GB.

- † The number of websites hosted on each Dedicated Server or Enterprise Server is dependent on total server bandwidth usage. Greater usage may result in fewer website properties per server. Cancellation of a Dedicated Server or Enterprise Server hosting plan requires 30 days notice. Dedicated Servers and Enterprise Servers must be purchased for a minimum of 3 months.


## Premium Hosting Benefits


Cost Efficient You can save money by having your own dedicated server with a large allocation of storage space and bandwidth that you can grow into, rather than pay for additional bandwidth allocation for your sites without any of the other advantages. Uptime + Security With a dedicated server your websites are completely isolated from other websites. That means if something goes wrong on a website in the standard hosting environment it will not impact the websites on your server, reducing the risk of downtime & security issues. Faster Load Times Websites load faster. All server resources will be dedicated to serving your websites – no other websites will be sharing the resources as they do in our standard website hosting. High Bandwidth Dedicated Servers and Enterprise Servers comes with a total allocation of 15 TB of bandwidth per month, which should cover significant growth for all of your sites without paying anything extra.


## General Information


24/7 Monitoring All of our dedicated servers are setup, monitored, and maintained 24/7 by our Server Management Team – the same team that monitors the entire Brilliant Directories network. The cost of this service is included in all of the prices above. Network Connection Each dedicated server has its own dual-redundant Gigabit Network Connection to the internet. This reduces latency when compared to websites sharing the same internet connection on our standard website hosting. Cutting Edge Data Center These servers are installed in our rack in the Hurricane Electric data center in New York. They are directly hardwired to our network, separate from the other servers in the data center. Need a Custom Server Configuration? Not a problem! To receive a customized dedicated server quote, please contact us at the following link with the server specifications you are interested in.
